summary: Yellow Chips makes organic potato chips and vegetable chips at its factory in Emmeloord, Netherlands. It began in 2013 and sells under its own GoPure brand and as private label across Europe. The About page says a team of 100 people works there.
products: Vegetable chips: parsnip, beet, sweet potato
markets: Sold in Berlin, Amsterdam, Stockholm and Madrid
facts: Began in 2013 near Emmeloord in the Noordoostpolder
BRCGS Grade AA certification announced 11 March 2025

contact.address: Yellow Chips B.V., Fabrieksweg 6, 8304 AT Emmeloord, The Netherlands

limitations: Ownership, processing capacity, potato volumes and turnover are not published on the pages read.
Number of growers, named customers and the organic certificate body are not published.
